title: Mutation Testing of Simulink Cyber-Physical System Models: Challenges and Solutions in Practice
abstract: arXiv:2608.24250v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Several experience reports illustrate that mutation testing is capable of supporting a shift-left testing strategy, especially in industries where late bug discovery incurs very high costs and risks. In the context of cyber-physical systems, a shift left implies that engineers need to test the design models used to simulate, prototype, and analyse the feasibility of the system under design. In this paper, we analyse the challenges we encountered and the lessons we learned when incorporating mutation testing in the context of DUCO, a company producing ventilation systems for buildings. The engineers within DUCO have years of experience with model-based engineering centered around Simulink and StateFlow, including unit tests for their models. During a pilot project with our tool prototype MUT4SLX we learned that equivalent mutants, requirement traceability, and mutation testing for Stateflow represent particular challenges not yet reported

translated_title: Simulink网络物理系统模型的变异测试：实践中的挑战与解决方案
translated_abstract: 多份经验报告表明，变异测试能够支持“左移”测试策略，尤其是在那些晚期发现缺陷会带来高成本和风险的行业中。在网络物理系统的背景下，“左移”意味着工程师需要测试用于模拟、原型设计和分析所设计系统可行性的设计模型。本文分析了我们在将变异测试应用于DUCO（一家生产建筑通风系统的公司）过程中遇到的挑战和吸取的教训。DUCO的工程师们在基于Simulink和StateFlow的模型驱动工程方面拥有多年经验，包括对模型进行单元测试。在使用我们的工具原型MUT4SLX进行的试点项目中，我们发现等效变异体、需求可追溯性以及StateFlow的变异测试代表了尚未被充分报告的特定挑战。
tldr: 本文通过DUCO公司的实践案例，揭示了在Simulink网络物理系统模型变异测试中遇到的等效变异体、需求可追溯性和StateFlow变异测试三大挑战，并提出了相应解决方案。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals three challenges in mutation testing of Simulink cyber-physical system models through DUCO's practice—equivalent mutants, requirement traceability, and StateFlow mutation testing—along with proposed solutions.
